description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Guidelines on Valuation of Property, Plant and Equipment, Investment Property and Biological Assets for the Purpose of Financial Reporting
reasoning: This gazette content publishes technical guidelines for the valuation of property, plant, equipment, investment property, and biological assets for financial reporting purposes under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and professional standards for valuation practices, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
